adrs.title: DR RTO/RPO Matrix Per Microservice Per Compliance Pack

slo_exemption.rationale: No current measured runtime SLI exists for this foundation, retired, or local-scaffold service; the manifest must not claim production or hyperscaler-ready SLO coverage until an OpenSLO file lands.

audit_chain.non_claim: Metadata guardrail records audit/evidence reference shapes only; no audit-chain writer or seal persistence is implemented by CS-CLOUD-OPS-FOUNDATION-001.

secrets_substrate.non_claim: No raw credential, provider token, kubeconfig, marketplace secret, or OpenBao runtime call is introduced or consumed.

runtime_dependencies.non_claim: No service runtime dependency graph is claimed for this local foundation.

dr.non_claim: No DR runtime or drill evidence is implemented.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No Istio/Cilium/Envoy runtime configuration is implemented by this slice.

iac.non_claim: No infrastructure provisioning is executed or claimed.

cloud_ops_foundation.non_claim: The guardrail proves tenant/region/cell-scoped metadata and capacity/rebalance bounds only; it does not run cloud operations workflows.

source_guidance.implication: capacity is resource based, per-customer quota aware, and overload/retry claims require measured runtime evidence
node autoscaling is runtime infrastructure behavior and is not claimed by this local foundation
FOCUS exports need schema-backed data generation evidence and are not claimed as live exports here
Kubernetes cost allocation needs asset/resource allocation data; this slice keeps only domain/API metadata
facility tier claims require site infrastructure evidence; this slice only validates pure DCOps domain records
SaaS marketplace sellers manage access/provisioning and integrate subscriptions/contracts; no live marketplace integration is claimed

non_claims: no live REST gRPC SDK worker database broker scheduler or dashboard runtime
no measured SLO SLI burn-rate Prometheus OpenSLO runtime evidence
no active-active DR failover drill backup restore or cross-region replication evidence
no OpenTofu plan/apply provider SDK Kubernetes controller or provider-live operation
no audit-chain writer Merkle seal persistence or external evidence-store runtime
no runtime autoscaling autosharding migration workflow or tenant move execution
no ops-dashboard-control-center crate family exists in the workspace
no incident command deployment command cluster health or operator dashboard runtime

substrate_dag_position._note: forward-declared per ADR-0280 Appendix C; edges land in DAG v1.1.0

bounded_contexts.name: dcops-domain-local-foundation
bounded_contexts.description: Compatibility dashboard manifest now distinguishes the code-backed DCOps domain from the unimplemented ops dashboard runtime. DCOps domain covers site/facility/power/cooling/security/rack/equipment/cable/BMS/work-order/sustainability records. No dashboard service crates, incident/deployment command runtime, cluster-health collector, REST/event/proto transport, database, measured SLO, active-active DR, or audit-chain persistence is claimed.

contracts.contract_status: service-local dashboard contracts are planning scaffolds; no ops-dashboard runtime crate or transport is implemented

dcops_facility_claims.non_claim: Facility standards guided domain boundaries, but no certified site, BMS telemetry, or dashboard runtime evidence is implemented.
